permutationLabel: Adult with known dermoid cyst (base case)
summary: 24-year-old woman, sudden right iliac fossa/pelvic pain for 5 h with repeated vomiting, known 6 cm right ovarian dermoid awaiting surgery; urine hCG negative; US: enlarged right ovary with reduced venous flow. Surgical emergency: laparoscopy and detorsion.

inputs.chiefComplaint: Sudden right lower abdominal pain with vomiting
inputs.hpi: Sudden onset of severe right lower abdominal and pelvic pain 5 hours ago while dancing, constant with waves of worsening, vomited four times. Known 6 cm right ovarian dermoid cyst on ultrasound 3 months ago, waiting for gynaecology. LMP 2 weeks ago, normal. Urine pregnancy test negative in triage. No fever, no urinary symptoms.

exam.abdomen: Tender right iliac fossa and suprapubic region with voluntary guarding; tender right adnexal fullness on bimanual examination.

imaging.name: USS pelvis (transvaginal) with Doppler
imaging.result: Enlarged right ovary 8 cm containing a 6 cm echogenic dermoid, peripheral follicles, markedly reduced venous flow and preserved but diminished arterial flow; small amount of free fluid. Appendix not seen. Left ovary normal.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Right ovarian torsion (dermoid cyst)
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Right ovarian torsion on a dermoid cyst: emergency laparoscopy with detorsion and ovarian-sparing cystectomy; gynaecology on call informed.

emergencyLevel.note: Ovarian viability is time-dependent: surgical emergency.

mustInclude.note: Detorsion and ovarian preservation, even when the ovary looks dusky.

mustExclude.note: Imaging shows ovarian torsion; an appendicectomy plan is a wrong-procedure suggestion.
mustExclude.knownGapNote: Web: computeClinicalPrompts fires the 'Appendicitis — emergency surgical indication' laparoscopic-appendicectomy operative plan (consent, theatre booking, post-operative orders, pip-tazo at induction). hasAppendicitisIndication fires on any affirmed 'guarding'/'rebound' in the abdominal exam ('voluntary guarding' from torsion) and ignores the confirmed diagnosis. The pelvic-free-fluid prompt also adds a 'Ruptured ectopic protocol' although the urine hCG is recorded negative.
mustExclude.proposedFix: Gate the appendicectomy operative-plan prompt on an appendicitis working diagnosis (as the Alvarado block does with assessmentHasAppend); guarding from torsion, PID, haemoperitoneum or DKA is not an appendicectomy indication.

guideline.name: ACOG Committee Opinion No. 783 — adnexal torsion in adolescents
guideline.section: Torsion is a surgical emergency: prompt laparoscopy; preserve the ovary (detorsion) even when it looks non-viable, rather than oophorectomy; normal Doppler flow does not exclude torsion
guideline.citation: American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists. Adnexal torsion in adolescents: ACOG Committee Opinion No. 783. Obstet Gynecol. 2019;134:e56–e63.

guideline.name: ACOG Practice Bulletin No. 174 — evaluation and management of adnexal masses
guideline.section: Pregnancy test in reproductive-age women with an adnexal mass and pain; transvaginal ultrasound; haemorrhagic corpus luteum cysts are usually managed conservatively unless haemodynamic compromise
guideline.citation: American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists. Evaluation and management of adnexal masses: Practice Bulletin No. 174. Obstet Gynecol. 2016;128:e210–e226.

rationale: Ovarian torsion is a classic mimic of appendicitis; ovarian salvage depends on prompt laparoscopy and detorsion rather than oophorectomy.
